description: A 'receipt': a white paper card with a small label, a headline, a line of text with the key words highlighted, and the source. Tilted slightly on the dark background. Write facts in your own words and always name the source.

fields.label: Small colored label on top, e.g. INJURY REPORT
fields.headline: Headline (your own words)
fields.body: Optional text under it. *words* get a highlighter background
fields.source: Where the fact comes from, e.g. Source: ESPN game recap, Oct 30, 2026
